headline: Audio Classifier の stream buffer と同期コストを可視化する
headlineEn: Visualizing Audio Classifier stream buffers and synchronous cost
summary: Google AI Edge の Audio Classifier Web guide、tasks-audio JavaScript API reference、AudioEmbedder API、MediaPipe samples-web、npm の @mediapipe/tasks-audio 情報を確認し、Audio Tasks をマイクストリームの ring buffer、解析窓、同期ブロック、類似度ルーティングとして扱う自作サンプルを2本追加しました。本命は Audio Classifier の window / overlap / queue を見る lab、派生は AudioEmbedder 風の cosine similarity と quantize を試す pulse map です。
summaryEn: After checking the Google AI Edge Audio Classifier Web guide, tasks-audio JavaScript API reference, AudioEmbedder API, MediaPipe samples-web, and npm information for @mediapipe/tasks-audio, this adds two original samples that treat Audio Tasks as microphone stream ring buffers, analysis windows, synchronous blocking, and similarity routing. The main sample watches Audio Classifier windows, overlap, and queues; the derivative tests AudioEmbedder-style cosine similarity and quantization.
keyTopics: Audio Classifier Web guide は `@mediapipe/tasks-audio`、`FilesetResolver.forAudioTasks()`、`AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`、`classify()` の Web 構成を示している。
同 guide は、Audio Classifier がリサンプリング、バッファリング、フレーミングを含む入力前処理を扱うことを説明している。
マイク入力で `classify()` を呼ぶ場合、同期実行が UI thread を block し得るため、Web Worker に逃がす設計が重要になる。
JavaScript API reference では `AudioClassifier.classify(audioData, sampleRate)` と `AudioEmbedder.embed(audioData, sampleRate)` が Float32Array を受け取ることを確認できる。
npm の @mediapipe/tasks-audio は latest 1.0.1、nightly / rc として 1.1.0-rc.20260916 が見えており、公開サンプルでは version pin と import probe を持たせる方針にした。
keyTopicsEn: The Audio Classifier Web guide shows the Web setup around `@mediapipe/tasks-audio`, `FilesetResolver.forAudioTasks()`, `AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`, and `classify()`.
The same guide explains that Audio Classifier handles input preprocessing including resampling, buffering, and framing.
When `classify()` is called on microphone input, synchronous execution can block the UI thread, making a Web Worker design important.
The JavaScript API reference confirms that `AudioClassifier.classify(audioData, sampleRate)` and `AudioEmbedder.embed(audioData, sampleRate)` accept Float32Array audio data.
npm shows @mediapipe/tasks-audio latest at 1.0.1 with a 1.1.0-rc.20260916 nightly / rc visible, so the public sample keeps version pinning and an import probe.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は、Audio Classifier を「音を分類するだけの task」ではなく、連続マイク入力を ring buffer に入れ、解析窓と overlap を決め、同期 `classify()` のコストをどこで吸収するかという runtime 設計として扱うことです。公式 guide は Audio Classifier がリサンプリング、バッファリング、フレーミングを扱うこと、そしてマイク入力では同期実行が UI thread を block し得ることを明記しているので、Web Worker、queue、drop policy まで含めた試作が有用です。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable angle is treating Audio Classifier not merely as a sound labeling task, but as a runtime design problem: continuous microphone input enters a ring buffer, analysis windows and overlap are chosen, and the cost of synchronous `classify()` has to be absorbed somewhere. The official guide explicitly notes preprocessing such as resampling, buffering, and framing, and warns that microphone classification can block the UI thread, so it is useful to prototype workers, queues, and drop policies together.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命サンプル `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab` は、合成波形の energy、window size、overlap、sync cost、smoothing を触り、分類スコア、queue、drop、UI block を可視化します。派生の `Audio Embedding Similarity Pulse Map` は、AudioEmbedder 風のベクトルを使って reference clip との cosine similarity、quantize、threshold route、novel event を見ます。音 UI では、分類名そのものより「いつ結果を採用するか」「どの程度似ていれば同じ音イベントとして扱うか」が体験を左右します。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab`, lets you adjust synthetic waveform energy, window size, overlap, sync cost, and smoothing while visualizing classification scores, queues, drops, and UI blocking. The derivative, `Audio Embedding Similarity Pulse Map`, uses AudioEmbedder-style vectors to watch cosine similarity, quantization, threshold routing, and novel events against a reference clip. In audio UI, the experience often depends less on the class name itself and more on when the result is accepted and how similar an event must be to count as the same sound.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.titleEn: Possibilities unlocked by sample data and combinations
sections.body: 蓄積できるデータは、ring buffer write position、window size、overlap、sample rate、classification score、top category、smoothed score、queue delay、drop count、UI block count、embedding vector、cosine similarity、threshold decision、novel event flag です。Audio Classifier、AudioEmbedder、Web Audio API、AudioWorklet、Web Worker、IndexedDB、Image Embedder、Gesture Recognizer、LLM の短文要約と組み合わせると、音に反応するライブ字幕、環境音トリガー、音と映像の類似イベント検索、長時間ログのハイライト抽出に発展できます。
sections.bodyEn: The samples can collect ring buffer write position, window size, overlap, sample rate, classification scores, top categories, smoothed scores, queue delay, drop counts, UI block counts, embedding vectors, cosine similarity, threshold decisions, and novel event flags. Combined with Audio Classifier, AudioEmbedder, Web Audio API, AudioWorklet, Web Workers, IndexedDB, Image Embedder, Gesture Recognizer, or short LLM summaries, this can grow into audio-reactive captions, ambient sound triggers, cross-modal event search, and highlight extraction from long-running logs.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 実装時は `FilesetResolver.forAudioTasks()`、`AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`、`AudioClassifier.classify(audioData, sampleRate)`、`AudioEmbedder.embed(audioData, sampleRate)`、`baseOptions.modelAssetPath`、`scoreThreshold`、`maxResults` を分けて計測します。実マイクでは `ScriptProcessorNode` より AudioWorklet を優先し、Float32Array chunk を worker に渡すか、worker 側で task を保持します。window が短いほど反応は速い一方で分類が揺れやすく、overlap が大きいほど安定しやすい一方で queue が伸びます。
sections.bodyEn: For implementation, measure `FilesetResolver.forAudioTasks()`, `AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`, `AudioClassifier.classify(audioData, sampleRate)`, `AudioEmbedder.embed(audioData, sampleRate)`, `baseOptions.modelAssetPath`, `scoreThreshold`, and `maxResults` separately. For real microphones, prefer AudioWorklet over ScriptProcessorNode and either transfer Float32Array chunks to a worker or keep the task in the worker. Shorter windows respond faster but wobble more; larger overlap stabilizes results but can grow the queue.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 明日以降は、Audio Classifier Web guide の worker / AudioWorklet 例、tasks-audio API の `setOptions()` 周り、AudioEmbedder の quantizedEmbedding / floatEmbedding、npm の nightly tag、MediaPipe release notes の JavaScript と audio modality 更新、mediapipe-samples-web の Audio Classifier 実装差分を見ます。特に実モデルで YAMNet の category latency と worker transfer cost を測りたいです。
sections.bodyEn: Next, watch the Audio Classifier Web guide for worker / AudioWorklet examples, tasks-audio API changes around `setOptions()`, AudioEmbedder quantizedEmbedding / floatEmbedding behavior, npm nightly tags, MediaPipe release notes for JavaScript and audio modality updates, and Audio Classifier diffs in mediapipe-samples-web. The concrete follow-up is measuring YAMNet category latency and worker transfer cost with a real model.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab` で `Window size` を小さくし、`Overlap` と `Sync cost` を上げてから `Noise burst` を押すと、反応速度、queue、drop、UI block の関係が見えます。派生サンプルでは `Quantize` を上げて `Novel event` を押し、同じ reference でも similarity route が hold に変わる瞬間を確認します。
sections.bodyEn: In `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab`, shrink `Window size`, raise `Overlap` and `Sync cost`, then press `Noise burst` to see the relationship between responsiveness, queues, drops, and UI blocking. In the derivative sample, raise `Quantize`, press `Novel event`, and watch the same reference flip from a similarity route to a hold.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Audio Classifier Web guide、tasks-audio package API、AudioClassifier / AudioEmbedder JS API、MediaPipe samples-web、npm @mediapipe/tasks-audio を確認。設計: 外部デモ一覧ではなく、自作 HTML で stream buffer lab と similarity pulse map を作る。実装: 本命 HTML に ring buffer、analysis window、overlap、synthetic score、queue、drop、UI block、import probe を追加。派生 HTML に synthetic embedding、cosine similarity、quantize、threshold route、reference swap、novel event を追加。検証: JSON parse、gallery build、publish command、GitHub Pages の top/day/sample HTTP 200 を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked the Audio Classifier Web guide, tasks-audio package API, AudioClassifier / AudioEmbedder JS APIs, MediaPipe samples-web, and npm @mediapipe/tasks-audio. Design: instead of listing external demos, build original HTML for a stream buffer lab and similarity pulse map. Implementation: added ring buffers, analysis windows, overlap, synthetic scores, queues, drops, UI blocking, and an import probe to the main HTML. Added synthetic embeddings, cosine similarity, quantization, threshold routing, reference swaps, and novel events to the derivative HTML. Validation: check JSON parse, gallery build, publish command, and HTTP 200 responses for top, day, and sample pages.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 直近は Gesture、Face、Segmenter、Image Embedder で、Vision task の frame budget、mask lifecycle、ROI drift、cache を見てきました。今日は Audio Tasks に戻し、映像フレームではなく音声 chunk の長さ、overlap、queue、embedding similarity を観察軸にしました。これで日次サンプルの実装メモに、Vision の frame loop と Audio の buffer loop を並べて比較できる基盤ができます。
sections.bodyEn: Recent entries covered Gesture, Face, Segmenter, and Image Embedder topics, focusing on frame budgets, mask lifecycles, ROI drift, and caches for Vision tasks. Today returns to Audio Tasks and shifts the observation axis from video frames to audio chunk length, overlap, queues, and embedding similarity. This creates a basis for comparing Vision frame loops with Audio buffer loops in the daily sample notes.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した本命は `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab` です。実際に動く部分は、合成波形、ring buffer write position、analysis window、overlap、synthetic classification score、smoothing、queue / drop / UI block meter、Tasks Audio import probe です。次に足すなら実 `AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`、YAMNet model、microphone permission flow、AudioWorklet、worker handoff を足します。派生試作は `Audio Embedding Similarity Pulse Map` で、実際に動く部分は AudioEmbedder 風の synthetic embedding、cosine similarity、quantize、reference swap、threshold route、novel event spike です。次に足すなら実 `AudioEmbedder.createFromModelPath()`、短い音声クリップ、query-by-example UI、IndexedDB による embedding 履歴保存を足します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `Audio Classifier Stream Buffer Lab`. The working pieces are a synthetic waveform, ring buffer write position, analysis windows, overlap, synthetic classification scores, smoothing, queue / drop / UI block meters, and a Tasks Audio import probe. Next additions should connect real `AudioClassifier.createFromOptions()`, a YAMNet model, microphone permission flow, AudioWorklet, and worker handoff. The derivative prototype is `Audio Embedding Similarity Pulse Map`; the working pieces are AudioEmbedder-style synthetic embeddings, cosine similarity, quantization, reference swaps, threshold routing, and novel event spikes. Next additions should include real `AudioEmbedder.createFromModelPath()`, short audio clips, query-by-example UI, and IndexedDB embedding history.
